predecessor.provenance_contract: Verify the predecessor manifest binding when available, record the exact supplied provenance SHA-256, and require every raw-source and prepared-CSV identity below to agree. A pathname alone is insufficient.
predecessor.residue: Exact complete-pattern lookup selected two bars; longer windows became almost entirely unseen. No primary incremental result beyond lag-one direction passed the predecessor criterion. R1 pools atomic relationships rather than treating each full configuration as a separate identity.
predecessor.prior_exposure: All 2020-01-01 through 2026-10-07 snapshots and the predecessor's 2025-2026 outcomes have already been inspected. Every fold in this protocol is retrospective. Neither nesting nor this new protocol makes these observations fresh or previously untouched.

rounds.hypothesis_family: Additive pooled geometry beyond sign history
rounds.scope: Completed R1 numerical failure and separately frozen R1a solver amendment in PR24 and PR25; retain both records and the audited outcomes.

rounds.hypothesis_family: A small economic-selection family can exploit conditional payoffs after declared costs
rounds.scope: Completed R2 test of direct conditional payoff ridge and the seven fixed policies; retain all audited outcomes, controls and numerical audit-development receipts.

rounds.hypothesis_family: Limited interpretable geometry interactions add information beyond additive models
rounds.scope: This R3 specification: exactly 225 reachable body/range interval and joint-orientation onehot columns for the current/prior pair, added to the unchanged additive geometry feature family. No full body-by-range cross, additional lag interactions or learned vocabulary.

campaign.stopping_rule: Stop without a positive-edge claim when the three-round budget is exhausted or the recorded residue does not justify another declared round. Do not extend the search merely until a favorable backtest appears.
campaign.governance: Each named results or performance attempt follows CLAUDE.md Law 1: a pre-run falsifiable claim, criterion and method; complete observations; supported/not-supported/inconclusive outcome; retained failures, deviations, residue and next steps. Any scientific change after this freeze requires a versioned amendment and a new named attempt before execution.
campaign.future_confirmation: A supported R3 criterion is conditional retrospective evidence under an OHLC execution proxy. Any eventual live tradeability claim requires a separately frozen future-data evaluation and execution evidence. This campaign does not authorize real-money orders or paid compute.
campaign.current_family: R3, the third and final hypothesis family. Stop this campaign after its complete recorded outcome; R1/R1a and R2 remain separately retained.

data.price_semantics: Finite positive IEEE-754 binary64 OHLC values, exact comparisons, no epsilon or inferred tick size. Low <= min(open,close) <= max(open,close) <= high. Volume is validated as source data but is never a feature.
data.time_semantics: Original UTC candle opening timestamps, strictly increasing and on the timeframe grid. Preserve actual source rows, reject duplicates and off-grid times, never fill prices or compress gaps.
data.outer_gap_audit: The 2023-03-24 outer-period gap contains 10 missing 15-minute bars, 5 missing 30-minute bars, 2 missing 60-minute bars and 1 missing 120-minute bar; 240-minute outer data have no gap. Outer 2024 through the exclusive 2026-10-08 end are continuous. Recompute and verify this timestamp-only statement before reporting economics.

native_features.causal_eligibility: Source row t has ten actual consecutive candles t-9 through t, all at or after history_start. No future candle or label is consulted. Include the final source row when its past window is valid.
native_features.feature_source: Every A and I feature is decoded from this same native oriented ten-bar key, including the fixed current/prior interval catalogue. No raw numeric return, absolute price, ratio, volume or non-geometry feature enters A or I.

binary_abi.record: 40 bytes, struct <5Q: zero-based original CSV data-row index excluding header, then GeometryKey words 0,1,2,3; concatenate words least-significant first into 256 bits.
binary_abi.key_bits: Endpoint rank at bit 6*(4*lag+endpoint), width six bits, for lags 0..9 and endpoint indices 0..3. Bits 240..249 are per-lag up flags, set iff close>open. Bits 250..253 hold literal width 10. Bit 254 is oriented=1. Bit 255 is reserved=0. Down versus flat is distinguished by unequal versus equal body ranks when the up flag is zero.
binary_abi.seal: Final 64 bytes are the lowercase ASCII hex SHA-256 of all preceding bytes. Total length is 168 + 40*record_count + 64. Reject trailing bytes, invalid ranks/flags, duplicate/unordered indices, or mismatching context/source identities.

native_features.manifest_contract: manifest.sha256 is the final completion marker and hashes manifest.json exact bytes. Bind the context, record count, keys payload and whole-file hashes/bytes, engine identity and timings hash before decoding.

features.shared_history: All fitting, validation and outer classification rows use the same causal n10 validity, including candidates with shorter n. Forecast-policy economics also uses that causal n10 validity; future-label validity never suppresses a causal prediction.

A.description: Exactly the R2 G additive qualitative geometry family. Refit freshly inside R3; no coefficients, validation scores, policies, predictions or target statistics reused from R2.
A.column_order: The exact common.feature_names(n, G) order: 2*n body signs; 2*(n-1) close-return signs; 32*(n-1) current-to-prior endpoint less/equal indicators; 2*n wick-presence indicators. Flat/greater categories omitted exactly as in R2.

I.description: A followed by two complete onehot catalogues for the current (lag0) and immediately prior (lag1) candle: body-interval weak order conditioned on their joint body directions; then full low-high interval weak order conditioned on the same joint directions.
I.column_order: A in its exact order, then 75 body catalogue entries, then 150 range catalogue entries. Stable catalogue ordering and names are fixed in the catalogue contract; no columns selected from market support.

catalogue.construction: Enumerate all qualitative configurations compatible with valid OHLC, including zero bodies, absent wicks, point candles and equality across candles. Canonicalize each projected endpoint tuple to its own dense weak-order ranks. Exclude only mathematically impossible combinations; preserve every reachable catalogue column even if no market fitting row activates it.
catalogue.directions: Three categories for each candle: down=-1 when body_bottom<body_top and upflag=0, flat=0 when endpoints equal, up=1 when upflag=1. The native flat-body upflag must be zero.
catalogue.canonical_order: All body records first, then all range records. Within each block order lexicographically by signed tuple (current_direction,prior_direction,current_bottom_rank,current_top_rank,prior_bottom_rank,prior_top_rank), directions -1,0,1 and dense ranks0..3. Global interaction indexes0..74 are body and75..224 are range; local range indexes0..149. Column names exactly match each catalogue record name.
catalogue.serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON, sorted keys, ASCII escapes, allow_nan=False, no trailing newline; payload has version filang-interval-interactions-v1 and ordered records list. Each record binds index,block,local_index,directions,ranks,name.

features.representation: Fixed uint8 binary indicators evaluated in float64, with no scaling, learned encoding, empirical support filtering, constant-column removal, additional lag interaction or full body-by-range crossing. Retain the complete defined columns and penalize all coefficients with the same declared lambda. Both onehot groups sum to one and overlap in their joint-direction span; the additive family also creates redundancy. Positive ridge penalties make the fitted objective unique despite those redundant spans. This specific redundant basis and its penalty geometry are part of the model. No arbitrary reference dummy is dropped, no extra direction-pair dummies are added, and no invariance to reparameterization or matched-capacity claim is made.

runtime.hardware_target: Apple M1 Max, 10 logical cores, 64 GiB RAM
runtime.concurrency: Before importing numerical libraries, explicitly set and record VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, OMP_NUM_THREADS and other relevant thread controls. Use bounded process parallelism; record chosen workers and per-process limits before execution. These operational settings are not scientific tuning axes.
runtime.configuration_receipts: Retain Python/package/platform versions, numpy.show_config and available runtime/BLAS details, threadpoolctl output even when empty, environment thread controls, process limits, code/engine hashes, exact commands and per-stage timings/peak memory. Apple Accelerate may not appear in threadpoolctl.
runtime.performance_claims: Record source/key preparation, sufficient-statistics construction, fitting/scoring, policy/ledger work, inference, serialization and full independent audit timings separately with workers/thread limits and peak memory. Statistics reuse and the vectorized request adapter are implementation choices; this results attempt makes no matched speedup claim. Separately measure synthetic exact-integer inference overhead before protocol publication; it may inform implementation efficiency, never scientific thresholds or outcome selection.

protocol_status: Publish this exact specification and bind its freeze commit before any R3 market fitting, selection, outer forecasts or outcome evaluation. Implementation drafts and synthetic verification may precede publication. Start R3 market work only after PR26 is merged and that merge is verified.
claim: A fixed low-order qualitative interaction extension of the additive candle-geometry conditional log-return model supports a validation-selected long/cash policy with positive net log returns and incremental net log returns beyond the identically selected additive geometry model, under the declared next-open execution proxy and primary costs.
primary_scope: Economic improvement of selected interaction I over freshly fitted additive geometry A and cash under fixed primary costs. This is not a wick-specific effect, equal-capacity comparison, demonstrated live tradeability or excess return over passive Bitcoin exposure.

round_predecessor.residue: R2 completed all 680 fits and 820 ledgers and passed its full independent audit. Its economic criterion was not-supported at all 5 timeframes; every composite Holm p was 1, and no G timeframe had 20 trades or the same 3 positive years. G net results matched B at 15/60m and U at 240m; positive pooled returns mostly reflected long exposure in 2024/2025 and no exposure in 2023/2026. Buy-and-hold exceeded G at all 5 timeframes. A sparse 30m daily contrast exposed floating equality sensitivity; both audit attempts and unchanged producer p-values are retained. R3 tests a fixed nonlinear geometry composition beyond a fresh additive geometry comparator and separately freezes exact binary-rational tail arithmetic, without reclassifying R2 or altering its policies, costs or targets.
round_predecessor.prior_exposure: All pinned 2020-2026 observations, predecessor results, R1/R1a and R2 outer outcomes are already exposed. This complete R3 procedure is retrospective; chronological nesting cannot create fresh confirmation. The fixed interaction family is motivated by those prior outcomes and is not corrected by within-round Holm adjustment for the whole adaptive research history.

target_and_phases.decision_information_time: timestamp[t]+interval_seconds, the scheduled close of the current source candle
target_and_phases.flat_policy: Include every valid target, including exactly zero log returns, in ridge fitting and MSE. Invalid or boundary-crossing targets are excluded. Causal prediction production and ledgers never consult future target validity.
target_and_phases.boundary_rule: Apply the strict target-exit cutoff independently for inner training, validation and refit. Feature history may extend before validation/outer start because it is already known; labels may not extend to or beyond the fitting/phase cutoff.
target_and_phases.regression_eligibility: Require all 12 original rows t-9..t+2 to be present and consecutive on the timeframe grid, with the ten feature candles in declared history. The current candle's OPEN timestamp must be >= phase_start and the target exit OPEN timestamp[t+2] must be strictly < phase_end. Do not import a prior-phase candle merely because its close is at the boundary.
target_and_phases.arithmetic: Evaluate np.log(O[t+2]/O[t+1]) in float64; exact equal positive opens produce exactly zero. No clipping, winsorizing, target scaling or outlier deletion.

estimation.model: mu = intercept + X @ beta, an unbounded signed float64 forecast of the next executable reference interval log return.
estimation.objective: sum((y-intercept-X@beta)**2)/(2*N) + lambda*sum(beta**2)/2; intercept unpenalized; all fixed binary features unscaled.

solver.formula: xbar=mean(X,axis=0), ybar=mean(y); H=X.T@X/N-outer(xbar,xbar)+lambda*I; rhs=X.T@y/N-xbar*ybar; beta=cho_solve(cho_factor(H,lower=True,check_finite=True),rhs,check_finite=True); intercept=ybar-xbar@beta. Algebraically equivalent augmented normal equations are permitted.
solver.constraints: No jitter, pseudoinverse, alternate solver, extra regularization or removal of constant columns. Every required factorization and solve must succeed.
solver.acceptance: All coefficients, objective and direct analytic gradient finite; successful Cholesky; maximum absolute gradient over intercept and beta <=1e-10. Recompute objective and gradient directly from the original fitting matrix/target, not merely from cached normal statistics. Record centered normal-equation residual as a diagnostic. No class-diversity requirement for regression.

estimation.normal_statistics_cache: Within this attempt only, permit reuse of full I10 sufficient statistics for an EXACT same fitting sample. Bind source/native/feature-column identities, ordered fitting-row hash, target-array hash, count and strict phase bounds. Project each family/history by exact feature-name lookup: shorter A/I is not a contiguous prefix. Record statistics identity and cache provenance on every fit; no R1/R1a/R2 coefficients, scores or target statistics may substitute. Saved terminal objective and gradient must still be computed directly from data. The binary Gram construction may exploit the fixed two-onehot interaction structure with sparse products or exact integer counts, computing the same full mean/Gram/cross-products. Such arithmetic is an implementation choice, not a feature or model change. All counts must avoid overflow and all retained normal statistics must independently match direct sums under the frozen comparison tolerance.
estimation.selection: For each timeframe/outer fold, A and I independently evaluate all 4 histories x4 penalties on the INNER-training fitting sample and select by INNER-validation mean squared error over all valid targets, including zeros. Scores within 1e-12 of the minimum form the tie set; prefer shorter n, then larger lambda. No outer label participates in its own fold selection. Refit the selected model on all permitted earlier data, even when its selected policy is cash.
estimation.failure_policy: Retain a failed fit with its reason and available numeric payload before aborting the affected worker. Do not drop a candidate, relax acceptance, shrink the family or promote a partial positive result. Missing or failed required fits make the round inconclusive pending a separately named pre-run amendment.

descriptive_baselines.unconditional_mean: For each fold, U predicts the arithmetic mean log return on the same valid INNER-training sample for validation, and on the same valid pre-year refit sample for outer. Include zeros, no smoothing, clipping or shrinkage. Preserve both means and fitting sample identities. Give U the same seven validation policy candidates and selection rule as A/I.
descriptive_baselines.interpretation: U and buy-and-hold are mandatory descriptive controls. They do not provide an alternative success route, nor does the primary test establish superiority to them. Clearly disclose if a nominal A/cash result is weaker than these controls.

economics.instrument_and_exposure: BTCUSDT spot, normalized initial equity 1, long/cash positions {1,0}, no leverage, no shorting, no borrowing, no funding or cash yield.
economics.timeline: Run on full original observed timestamps and opens, independently of future classification-label eligibility. Produce a signed forecast for every causally valid n10 feature row in the phase, including rows whose future classification label is absent. Never suppress a signal because a future bar is missing.
economics.signal_and_execution: At an observed opening j, apply only the signal from immediately preceding observed candle j-1, whose scheduled information time is timestamp[j-1]+interval_seconds. Its source candle OPEN must be >= outer_start. If the next grid bar is absent, retain the queued decision and assume execution at the next observed open. Report delay=max(0,timestamp[j]-signal_close).
economics.gap_policy: Carry existing holdings over the actual price change to the next observed open. Never exit or erase P&L before a future gap. After a gap makes past n10 history unavailable, forecast policies request cash at the first subsequently known candle close. A missing dataset bar is not evidence the exchange was closed: delayed fills are an explicit diagnostic proxy, not reconstructed live fills.
economics.reset_and_end: Start each outer fold in cash with no imported pending signal. Force cash at the last observed opening strictly before outer_end, charge a sale if long, and prohibit a new entry at that terminal opening. Every fold is an administratively independent ledger.
economics.buy_hold: Desired long after the first in-fold observed candle, independent of n10 feature availability; hold across gaps until the shared scheduled terminal liquidation. Cash/reset/fill/mark/cost conventions otherwise match the forecast policies.
economics.cost_interpretation: Fixed sensitivity scenarios, not asserted account-specific or historical exchange fees. The primary diagnostic is fee10+slippage2 bps per side; no favorable scenario substitutes for it.
economics.ledger_math: Let f=fee_bps/10000 and s=slippage_bps/10000. While long, mark equity by O[j]/O[previous_observed]. A buy at O*(1+s), charging fee from cash, multiplies mid-mark equity by (1-f)/(1+s). A sell at O*(1-s) with fee f multiplies equity by (1-s)*(1-f). Cash earns zero. Charge only exposure changes, including terminal liquidation.
economics.daily_allocation: Allocate each observed-opening marked return and cost to the UTC date of that opening; retain every calendar day. The continuous 2024+ summary concatenates independently reset 2024,2025,2026 annual ledgers rather than carrying positions secretly across their boundaries.
required_outputs: net/gross returns and daily log returns
annualized daily-log Sharpe with zero cash yield
cost drag and fixed-path cost break-even
gap durations and gap-crossing marked returns
economics.limitations: OHLC opens are execution reference prices, not guaranteed fills after a closed-candle event. These data do not establish spread, depth, market impact, order-size capacity or sub-bar latency. Open-marked drawdown is not a reconstruction of the intrabar path.
economics.status: R3 primary economic evaluation uses primary costs; remaining cost scenarios and risk/performance summaries are descriptive.
economics.forecast_units: Signed log-return mu. An exposure-request adapter may feed 0/1 or NaN requests to the unchanged audited probability-threshold ledger at 0.5/0.5, provided the signed forecast is preserved separately and the ledger input is explicitly labelled signal_request, never a forecast probability.

policy_family.round_trip_hurdle: k=-log((1-f)**2*(1-s)/(1+s)), f=10/10000 and s=2/10000. Evaluate using float64 math.log; k>0.
policy_family.candidates: The Cartesian product of the 3 entry and 2 exit multiples gives 6 active policies; cash is a seventh candidate. Both thresholds use the PRIMARY k for all cost scenarios. No holding-horizon, volatility, leverage, short, position-sizing or additional threshold axis.
policy_family.state_rule: Start each phase in cash. While cash, request long iff finite mu>=entry. While long, stay long iff finite mu>=exit. Thus mu=exit<entry preserves the existing position. A NaN causal forecast requests cash. Requests become executable only at the next observed opening after that candle information time, retaining original gap, delay and terminal rules.
policy_family.selection: Use only the selected INNER-training model full-row causal validation forecasts, never the pre-outer refit. Replay all 7 policies at primary costs. Maximize validation total net log return. Within 1e-12 of the maximum, prefer cash, then lower one-way turnover, then higher entry, then lower exit, then stable lexicographic policy_id. Freeze selected policy with refitted model through outer year. U follows the same policy selector.
policy_family.cost_sensitivity: No model or policy re-selection at zero, reduced or stress costs. Keep the primary-cost thresholds and selected requests/path for every scenario.
policy_family.activity_gate: Require at least 20 completed I outer round trips across all 4 folds at primary costs, including prescribed terminal liquidations. This is an activity/support requirement, not an effective sample size, proof of independence, or exclusion of all passive-like behavior.

economics.phase_coverage: Retain all 420 INNER-validation policy trials (3 forecasters x7 policies x20 timeframe/folds) at primary costs, plus all 400 OUTER ledgers (selected A/I/U,cash,buy_hold x4 costs x20 timeframe/folds). No validation sensitivity grid is required.

inference.unit: UTC observed-opening marked daily net log returns; all calendar days in each outer fold, including inactive/zero-return days; equal per-day weight. Cash return is zero.
inference.pooling: Concatenate the 4 administratively reset outer calendar folds; pooled effect is total daily effect / total calendar days. Preserve every annual effect and the partial 2026 endpoint. Both comparisons use identical day axes and bootstrap draws.

bootstrap.method: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap, stratified by outer calendar fold, resampling the two daily effect arrays with identical indices.
bootstrap.draw_order: For replicate 0..1999 process outer years 2023,2024,2025,2026 ascending; in each D-day fold draw ceil(D/block_days) int64 starts uniformly from [0,D), append circular consecutive blocks, truncate to D. Reuse the exact same indices for both paired comparisons, every retained float replica and each exact integer multiplicity sum. Only this index-generation schedule is inherited; the R3 exact tail predicate is the separately defined integer rule.
bootstrap.estimate: Sum of resampled daily effect values divided by total full calendar days; a zero-return day has weight 1.
bootstrap.confidence_interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of ordinary bootstrap mean daily net-log effects, NumPy linear interpolation.
bootstrap.null_centering: For each comparison separately, subtract its global pooled mean daily effect from every calendar-day effect before resampling. Do not center each year separately.
bootstrap.one_sided_p: Interpret the executed binary64 daily contrasts as exact binary rationals. For each comparison let S be the exact sum over all original calendar days and T the exact sum with the shared replica multiplicities. Count the event T>=2*S using signed integer arithmetic after conversion to a common power-of-two denominator. Because every replica has the same total N calendar days, this is exactly equivalent to (T-S)/N >= S/N, the globally centered one-sided tail event. p=(1+number of exact true tail events)/(2000+1). There is no epsilon, padding or rounding of this predicate.
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional retrospective uncertainty for the frozen selected pipelines; this does not account away prior research exposure or establish a fresh confirmatory test.

exact_tail_arithmetic.input: For each original calendar-day binary64 effect, use its exact as_integer_ratio value after the ordinary executed I-minus-A subtraction (or I for cash). Treat +0 and -0 as integer zero.
exact_tail_arithmetic.common_denominator: For each comparison independently, choose the greatest power-of-two denominator of its finite daily values (all-zero denominator1). Rescale signed numerators to that common denominator exactly; do not rescale fitted targets or features.
exact_tail_arithmetic.event: T>=2*S, with T=sum(integer_numerator*integer_resampling_multiplicity) across all four folds and S=sum(original integer_numerator). Integer multiplication/summation may be vectorized; no float sum may decide the exact event.
exact_tail_arithmetic.shared_indices: Use the exact same circular block indices for the float replicas, exact multiplicities and both comparisons. Draw once per fold/replica in the existing declared order.
exact_tail_arithmetic.retention: Retain complete exact daily integer encoding and fold lengths in bootstrap-exact.json, with denominator exponents, decimal signed numerators, global sums, canonical digest and comparison order. Retain every exact tail event as a bool [2000,2] array for each block length, together with the ordinary/centered float64 arrays. All NPZ members remain real numeric/bool; no object array or pickle.
exact_tail_arithmetic.ordinary_estimation: The observed means and percentile confidence intervals remain the declared binary64 outputs. Centered float replicas remain diagnostics. Only the one-sided tail predicate is evaluated exactly. Explicitly report the source of p so it is not confused with counting rounded centered floats.
exact_tail_arithmetic.rationale: The prior R2 sparse contrast exposed equality mass where float summation changed literal tail counts. This separately frozen R3 definition removes that arithmetic ambiguity for the executed daily binary64 values. It does not eliminate approximation error in the economic account itself or make historically exposed observations fresh.

inference.composite_p: For each timeframe take max(p_I_minus_A,p_I_minus_cash), an intersection-union test of requiring BOTH positive effects. Then Holm-adjust the 5 composite timeframe p-values, ordered by raw composite p then ascending minutes.
inference.confidence_interval_interpretation: Report both individual percentile 95% intervals. They are not a joint simultaneous 95% confidence region. The composite Holm test controls the declared 5 timeframe family conditionally on this retrospective selected procedure, not the entire prior adaptive research campaign.
success_per_timeframe: Both pooled mean daily net-log effects >0
Both seven-day individual 95% interval lower endpoints >0
Holm-adjusted composite one-sided p<0.05 across all 5 timeframes
At least 3 of the SAME 4 outer years have BOTH annual I-minus-A and I-minus-cash net-log effects >0
At least 20 completed I outer round trips at primary costs
All required fits, predictions, policy choices, ledger/inference replays and exact artifact audits pass
inference.outcome: Supported for a timeframe only when every condition holds. A complete valid round failing any condition is not-supported; it does not prove zero geometry information. Any required fit, artifact or audit failure makes the round inconclusive and cannot be resolved by selectively reporting surviving timeframes.
descriptive_metrics: validation and outer mean_squared_error for A/I/U
2023 gap period and independently reset continuous 2024+ aggregates
drawdown, exposure, turnover, completed trades, active days and break-even costs

artifact_contract.paths: All run paths relative except explicitly recorded immutable external inputs and operational receipts. JSON forbids NaN/Infinity; NPZ uses numeric/bool arrays only, allow_pickle=False. Stable named records and array identities, final manifest+seal written last. No sampled or checksum-only claim of full scientific audit. R3 record schemas use filang-interaction-payoff-* for compact fits/statistics/selections/ledgers/arrays/features/analysis and corresponding geometry-interaction-payoff protocol/verification identities; no B/G aliases may substitute for A/I meanings.
artifact_contract.root: Exact frozen protocol.json, source provenance.json, run.json with freeze/protocol/code/data/native/runtime/command/settings/stage/timing identities, analysis.json with every outcome and criterion, features/fit/selection/ledger indexes as appropriate, manifest.json plus SHA256 completion marker. Later independent verification.json is separately bound and must not mutate original producer status or artifacts. Copy the exact fixed interaction catalogue to catalogue.json; its file SHA must equal the frozen source catalogue SHA. Feature records also bind every N-by-2 int16 interaction-index array by hash.
artifact_contract.per_timeframe: Compact fits.jsonl containing all 136 candidate/refit records with full coefficients, fitting rows/target hashes and strict bounds, objectives/direct gradients/solver acceptance/statistics provenance; selections.jsonl contains 12 A/I/U fold choices with all 7 policy trials, selected inner/refit model identities and U means; ledgers.jsonl contains 164 explicit unique records (84 validation + 80 outer) binding source/protocol/model/policy/phase/scenario, complete metrics and array member references; arrays.json indexes all binary member identities. Four year-named NPZ bundles may share immutable source axes and hold full predictions and ledger arrays. Equivalent compact grouping is permitted with exactly the same coverage. Include bootstrap-exact.json with complete per-comparison binary-rational input encodings shared by the three block lengths, and retain the exact bool tail event arrays in bootstrap.npz.
artifact_contract.prediction_arrays: For every timeframe/fold preserve validation and outer full-original-row arrays: int64 row_index,timestamp,entry_row,exit_row; bool causal_feature_valid,phase_mask,target_valid; int8 direction; float64 target_log_return,target_simple_return and mu_A,mu_I,mu_U. Invalid target entries use NaN plus explicit false mask and -1 rows; true zeros remain valid. mu is finite for every in-phase causal n10 row, even without a valid future target, and NaN elsewhere. Bind inner validation to INNER model, outer to selected pre-year refit.
artifact_contract.ledger_arrays: Retain every observed-opening trace, raw signed forecast/source reference, consumed exposure request, source/signal rows and times, delay, before/desired/after position, gross mark,cost,net logreturn; full calendar-day arrays; every completed trade and gap record. Compact numeric arrays plus named JSON metadata are permitted. No discarded losing/cash trial.
artifact_contract.fit_failure: Seal retained partial records and explicit exception/status as incomplete; preserve nonfinite numeric payloads in NPZ while JSON uses null with an explicit validity reason. Audit failed attempts separately before any new amendment.
artifact_contract.report_package: Commit compact full coefficient/choice/ledger/analysis records, protocol/source/native/code/runtime bindings, full audit and external launcher/execution/audit receipts. Retain large 20 annual NPZ bundles by exact bytes/hash/array member identities in reproducible external runs. Target fewer than 100 report files; compact grouping must not reduce required audit scope.

required_independent_audit.independence: No imports of producer feature/target/ridge/policy/ledger/inference computational helpers. May reuse previously independent verify_round1 raw-source/native/features/accounting/bootstrap helpers where semantics are unchanged. Reconstruct signed-score cash/share accounting directly from mu; do not merely feed producer exposure requests to its own ledger. Do not fit an optimizer during audit. Previously independent R2 target/ridge/account/selection helpers may be reused only where semantics are unchanged. Independently enumerate and reconstruct R3 interval/direction features from raw OHLC/native ranks; never import producer interaction computations.

All fixed A/I feature columns and masks/targets including exactly flat returns and strict exit cutoffs

synthetic_requirements: All 7452 valid oriented two-bar qualitative states yield exactly the declared 75 body and150 range catalogue entries, with point intervals, touching endpoints, absent wicks and all directions; independent raw-OHLC oracle and optimized decoder agree, and every reachable catalogue column is activated at least once.
